notes.title: Rhythm Hotel Update Log: Ver 0.3.2-beta

[/p][p]The update is now live. Many thanks to everyone who reported the problem! 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]🛠 Patch Notes:[/p][p]1. notes.title: Rhythm Hotel - Demo Out Now ！
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="pv7AB2Yob1k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Today is a day worth celebrating—we can finally say that the demo for Rhythm Hotel is now available! [/p][p]We look forward to everyone downloading and trying it out, and we welcome all kinds of feedback. [/p][p]If you like it, please consider adding it to your wishlist.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Who are we?[/b][/h3][p]We are three individuals deeply passionate about rhythm games and avid fans of Rhythm Heaven. [/p][p]The initial inspiration for creating Rhythm Hotel came from the pure joy we experienced with Rhythm Heaven—its unexpected visuals, absurdly funny scenarios, and perfectly timed rhythm—all of which left a lasting impression on us. [/p][p]We hope to bring this same joy to more players in our own unique way.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What is Rhythm Hotel?[/b][/h3][p]It is a hotel existing within a rift in time and space, where characters from different eras and worlds might accidentally find themselves staying. [/p][p]You’ll encounter Einstein taking a selfie with his tongue out, Socrates engaged in a kicking match with a donkey, and Zhang Fei determined to become cultured… [/p][p]Here, they’re on vacation, letting loose, and you’ll be personally arranging their “rhythm holidays.” [/p][p]We believe this setting will deliver plenty of laughs and surprises that feel both familiar and delightfully unexpected.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you to everyone who has been with us on this journey.[/b][/h3][p]First and foremost, we want to thank the players who participated in the playtests and everyone who has tried, supported, and encouraged us along the way. [/p][p]Your feedback and enthusiasm gave us the confidence to present this demo to a wider audience. [/p][p]We also want to extend a special thanks to all the collaborators who joined the project—it’s your countless days and nights of hard work that made this possible.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Demo Features[/b][/h3][p]💥  Easy to pick up, challenging to master: All levels can be played with just one key. But to master them? Syncopated rhythms, off-beats, rests, and subdivided rhythms—none can be avoided.[/p][p]💥 High-quality music: The demo features music by the renowned artist Onoken, with more tracks from other talented musicians to be included in the full game.[/p][p]💥 Historical figure references: Socrates’ “If a donkey kicks me, must I kick it back?” Einstein’s famous photo? Zhang Fei’s “Me too!”? These classic memes will be reinterpreted with a humorous twist.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s next for us?[/b][/h3][p]We will focus our efforts on developing additional levels and content. [/p][p]Due to our small team size, we won’t be able to juggle too many tasks at once.[/p][p]However, whether it’s feedback from playtests or suggestions following the demo’s release, we will approach every piece of input with careful consideration. [/p][p]Our sole goal is to deliver the best possible gaming experience. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]The hotel welcomes your collaboration![/b] [/h3][p]Rhythm Hotel has always aimed to create alongside players. [/p][p]We sincerely invite everyone to contribute ideas for level design—with your creativity, the hotel will become even more vibrant, leading to more unexpected gameplay and stories.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 「Rhythm Hotel」Showcases at 2025 G-Fusion Game Fest
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524448/f728cd03f5e9e032479a6d5ff48ef1013dea1f73.png"][/img][/p][p]At the "2025 G-Fusion Game Fest" held at Beijing from June 28th to 29th,[/p][p]「Rhythm Hotel」 captivated gamers with its unique art style and immersive rhythm gameplay.[/p][p]Snaking queues formed at its demo stations, and its themed merchandise flew off the shelves.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524448/88cf63adcc4864fbf722fa49ea1190b9ff1f2a4c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The expo took place at the Shougang International Convention and Exhibition Center, where the industrial-chic aesthetic and futuristic vibe evoked the Mako reactor-dotted cityscape of Midgar from Final Fantasy, creating a setting that perfectly complemented the gaming showcase.[/p][p]-[/p][p]If you have recommendations for game expos or gaming-related suggestions,[/p][p]join us on Discord and share your thoughts![/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.com/invite/ENet75YjE7"]https://discord.com/invite/ENet75YjE7[/url][/p]
